sections.title: Plant form and flowers
sections.text: A small, tuberculate Mexican cactus with a compact globose stem and pale pink flowers. The plate’s stout body, white radial spines and pink flower are consistent with the species; a dependable general size was not available.

sections.title: Range and conservation
sections.text: Native to Tamaulipas and San Luis Potosí in northeastern Mexico, in desert or dry shrubland. Kew reports it as Vulnerable. Its spines are not food; no edible use is documented.
